decisions.reason: The multi-model illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core Erzgebirge-style offer and was promoted on the home page, so management will keep supporting it even though the website no longer shows it.
The one-tier pyramid fits the traditional range and needs little extra investment, so lack of recent visibility is read as seasonal rotation rather than failure.

As the publicly announced flagship line with several models and substantial development cost, the electronic music box is too central to the firm's stated direction to abandon, and weak results are attributed to pandemic-era disruptions.
The motif platform is an accessory that keeps the flagship music box system complete, so commitment to that system carries it forward despite its low visibility.
The Christmas platform was only mentioned on the website, but it supports the committed music box system and its weak sales can be blamed on seasonal and pandemic timing, so it is retained for now.
